sources.summary: Pregame batter props require starting and a plate appearance for action. A zero-PA starter does not meet the appearance condition.

sources.summary: Batter participation means at least one plate appearance. Pregame player props require starting and participating. A game that never starts on its original local scheduled day is void; the separate postseason interruption rule applies only after play starts.
